title: Sem: New primitive for code understanding – not LSPs, but entities on top of Git
summary: Sem is a novel approach to code understanding that operates at the Git layer rather than relying on traditional Language Server Protocol (LSP). It provides entity-level abstractions built on top of Git repositories, enabling developers to understand code structure and relationships through a different paradigm than conventional tools.
problem_solved: Provides an alternative to LSP-based code understanding by offering entity-level abstractions directly from Git, potentially solving fragmentation and complexity issues in existing code intelligence tools.
why_valuable: It introduces a fundamentally different approach to code comprehension that could simplify tooling and provide more consistent code understanding across different languages and editors.
